decisions.reason: It kept its own page through 2024, which suggests performance at or above aspiration and a good fit with the firm's core analytics offering.
Its downgrade from a standalone page to a mere mention, together with the removal of similar tariff products, signals results below aspiration and makes resource reallocation more attractive.
Although less prominently marketed in 2024, it likely has supporting value for the firm's remaining location-based tools, so available slack justifies retaining it for now.
